answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with live challenge-response fingerprinting — each identity a quill in its own hand. Step 1: every epoch the network issues a unique micro-task to each identity. Step 2: answers must arrive in ninety seconds with natural latency variance. Step 3: identical timing signatures across identities mark a farm. Step 4: three flags burn the identity and seize its earnings. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 concurrent inference sessions, about $5,000 per epoch. Sybils march like violet ants through karst tunnels, one scent; the hive collapses when lit.
